Law's Squad was a unit of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] led by [[Clone Lieutenant/Legends|Clone Lieutenant]] [[Law]] that accompanied [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[B'ink Utrila]] and her [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Rennax Omani]] on a [[Mission to Draay 2|mission]] to [[Draay 2]] to find the [[Order of the Sith Lords|Sith]] relic the [[Gauntlet of Kressh the Younger]].

==Description==
The [[Squad/Legends|squad]] was composed of four [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] equipped with [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15 blaster carbines]], they were led by [[Clone Lieutenant/Legends|Clone Lieutenant]] [[Law]] and sported [[Color/Legends|purple]] markings on their [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|armor]].<ref name="TCW" />

==History==
After finding the [[Gauntlet of Kressh the Younger]], the squad rested along with their accompanying [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] but found themselves in a brief engagement with the terrorist group [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]]. During the attack [[Rennax Omani]] was captured by Death Watch forcing the squad to cease fighting. [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]] offered [[Horns]] to join Death Watch if he killed [[B'ink Utrila]] but Horns declined. While Horns and Vizsla were talking, [[Glitch]] was able to grab Omani's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], engaging Vizsla in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]]. During the [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]] between Glitch and Vizsla, the temple began to collapse, but the squad and Jedi were able to escape except for Glitch. But after a moment, Glitch emerged from the rubble wearing the Gauntlet, but discarded it into a nearby river.<ref name="TCW" />
